comments.body:
[AGENTS.md](https://github.com/fixture-owner/ai-skills-eval-guided-review/blob/32d42d74153c02ff2928196efde4f3ea1a7e70b9/AGENTS.md#L6) asks for a test on the boundary of every threshold, and 3 sits well inside it. Worth pinning both sides of `LOW_STOCK`:

```suggestion
    assert stock.is_low("pears")


def test_an_item_at_the_threshold_is_low():
    assert Stock({"pears": 5}).is_low("pears")


def test_an_item_just_above_the_threshold_is_not_low():
    assert not Stock({"pears": 6}).is_low("pears")
```

The test at 5 fails until the comparison on [levels.py:16](https://github.com/fixture-owner/ai-skills-eval-guided-review/blob/32d42d74153c02ff2928196efde4f3ea1a7e70b9/stock/levels.py#L16) becomes `<=`, so the two changes go in together.

held: [docs/USAGE.md](https://github.com/fixture-owner/ai-skills-eval-guided-review/blob/32d42d74153c02ff2928196efde4f3ea1a7e70b9/docs/USAGE.md#L3-L8) still shows plain `name: quantity` lines and ends with "Nothing else appears on a line.", which no longer holds now that low items end in ` (low)`. [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/fixture-owner/ai-skills-eval-guided-review/blob/32d42d74153c02ff2928196efde4f3ea1a7e70b9/AGENTS.md#L5) asks for docs to move in the same change. The suggestion is to show `pears: 3 (low)` in the example and replace that last sentence with one saying the suffix marks items at or below [`LOW_STOCK`](https://github.com/fixture-owner/ai-skills-eval-guided-review/blob/32d42d74153c02ff2928196efde4f3ea1a7e70b9/stock/levels.py#L1-L2), without repeating its value.
